name: clean
description: Clean Architecture: Infra→App→Domain layer direction, pure domain, DIP.
one_liner: Clean Architecture: Infra → App → Domain, never backward; Domain has 0 external deps
unchecked_guidance: Domain has 0 external deps (framework/DB/HTTP): guidance only, no script checks it (architecture.clean.domain-pure and that part of layer-direction). domain -> infrastructure is the baseline clean_arch/direction check.

rules.guidance: Dependency direction: Infrastructure → Application → Domain. Domain layer has zero external (framework/DB/HTTP) imports. Violations are hard architecture errors.
Domain entities and use-cases depend only on each other and stdlib. No ORM annotations, HTTP status codes, or framework annotations in domain classes.
High-level modules define interfaces (ports). Low-level modules implement them (adapters). Dependency inversion enables replacing infrastructure without touching domain.
Each use-case class or function represents a single business action. Avoid fat service classes with 10+ methods — split by cohesion.
